QorCap v0.3.30: TPM device key on Intel PTT

`qorcap device-key init` now creates the TPM-backed key in the Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider. `receipt.v0.json` is unchanged and the software-key fallback is kept.

- PR #62: `NCryptIsAlgSupported` was called with `NCRYPT_SILENT_FLAG`, which the Platform Crypto Provider rejects with `NTE_BAD_FLAGS` (`0x80090009`). Neither ECDSA P-256 nor RSA-2048 was tried and init fell back to the software key. The algorithm check and `NCryptDeleteKey` now pass flags 0, so a failed create no longer leaves a key behind, and the fallback message records each call's HRESULT. Run `qorcap device-key init` again on a PC that fell back to replace the software key record with the TPM key `QorCap-Device-Attest-v0`.
